description: Set the Content Collector and Content Placer options: show the conveyor, create links and map styles when placing (Content Placer options, View > Extras > Show Conveyor). Pass no options to read them.

createLinks.description: Create Link: placed items stay linked to their source

mapStyles.description: Map Styles: apply custom style mappings to placed items

showConveyor.description: Show the conveyor when the Content Collector or Placer tool is chosen

name: set_content_placer_options
title: Set Content Placer Options
